buildings.name: GTS Global Intelligence — Calea Călărașilor 101

facts.type: single-storey eclectic (Beaux-Arts) town house, listed historic monument LMI B-II-m-B-18379 (OSM heritage=2)
facts.storeys: 1 (OSM building:levels=1) + mansard roof storey with a dormer
facts.footprint: ≈272 m², about 10 m street frontage × 30 m deep (long axis N–S, bearing 8°)
facts.street_side: N side of Calea Călărașilor (odd numbers), facing south onto the street; tram tracks in the carriageway
facts.facade: cream / pale-pink render (photo: warm off-white ≈ #E6DCCD) with horizontal rustication grooves, a grey-washed rendered plinth with patches of spalled render; tall round-arched windows (3 on the street front) with white wooden frames and fanlight glazing, each framed by a stucco laurel-garland arch and a scroll keystone/cartouche; a balustrade panel (small turned balusters) under every window; deep cornice with modillions and a frieze of stucco garlands and ribbons; chamfered/rounded street corner with a narrow arched window
facts.roof: grey sheet-metal (zinc) mansard, visibly weathered with patchy paint, with a round-arched dormer with stucco surround and round œil-de-bœuf vents (oculi with stucco frames); grey rainwater pipes
facts.entrance: not on the street: a black wrought-iron double gate and railing on the WEST side of the house opens onto a paved courtyard drive; the entrance is a white panelled double door with glazed upper part and a transom, reached by three stone steps on the long west façade, flanked by an iron lantern and conifers (thuja) in a lawn strip
facts.signage: only small door plaques beside the entrance (photo 2023: several small company plaques on the door jamb, one with a "BYG" logo) and a small pictorial board on the fence; in 2013 a red "DE ÎNCHIRIAT / FOR RENT" banner hung on the street front and a red vertical "GENERALI" banner on the side — no rooftop or billboard signage. Recommendation: a brass/acrylic plaque "GTS Global Intelligence" (≈ 40 × 30 cm) on the door jamb; no billboard
facts.neighbours: west (behind the gate): a new white 6–7-storey apartment block with glass balconies (built by 2023, set back in the courtyard); east: a two-storey eclectic house with a red standing-seam roof, dormers and red awnings over shopfronts, then no. 105 (1936, 6 storeys, OSM w245117686, listed B-II-m-B-18381); Hala Traian (no. 133) ≈240 m east
facts.occupancy_note: GTS at no. 101 comes from a group-level job listing (medium); the trade-register seat is Str. Frunzei 26 and GTS later moved to Hermes Business Campus (earlier dossier bucharest-unirii.json stops.gts)
